# runpod_cluster (Data Source)

A single cluster looked up by identifier. Member pods are listed by the runpod_cluster_pods data source.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_cluster" "training" {
  id = "cluster_abc123"
}

output "cluster_ready" {
  description = "Whether every member pod of the cluster is running."
  value       = lookup(data.runpod_cluster.training.pods_by_status, "RUNNING", 0) == data.runpod_cluster.training.pods_total
}

output "entry_point" {
  description = "SSH endpoint of the primary node; null until it is RUNNING with SSH exposed."
  value       = data.runpod_cluster.training.primary_ssh_endpoint
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cluster identifier, e.g. "cluster_abc123".

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the cluster is placed in; null until at least one pod is placed.
- `gpu_count_per_pod` (Number) Number of GPUs on each pod.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type every pod in the cluster runs on.
- `name` (String) Cluster display name.
- `network_cidr` (String) CIDR block of the cluster's private overlay network.
- `network_vxlan_id` (Number) VXLAN network identifier; null until assigned.
- `network_vxlan_port` (Number) UDP port carrying the VXLAN traffic; null until assigned.
- `pod_count` (Number) Number of pods (nodes) the cluster was created with.
- `pods_by_status` (Map of Number) Member pod counts keyed by pod status; statuses with no pods are absent.
- `pods_total` (Number) Number of member pods currently provisioned.
- `primary_pod_id` (String) Pod id of the primary (rank 0) node; null until a primary pod is placed.
- `primary_ssh_endpoint` (String) Public SSH endpoint (host:port) of the primary node; null until it is RUNNING with SSH exposed.
- `primary_status` (String) Lifecycle status of the primary node.
- `template` (String) Template the member pods were created from; null when they were not created from one.
- `type` (String) Cluster type: TRAINING, SLURM, RAY, or APPLICATION.
